name: Scandal
source:
This is a sequel to the popular "YaruDora" series. The main character, Saki Kitazawa, is a scoop cameraman, currently working on a contract basis at a small production. Her profession is greatly influenced by her father (now missing), who used to be a famous press corps. One day, she receives a scandalous information on a famous rock musician, Jill Sauzer. She then manages to slip into Jill's celebrity party and takes some shots of his scandalous acts with his secret girlfriend. However, it turns out that some of the photos she took of Jill and his girlfriend, have captures some important scenes of a crime. Since then, Saki is aimed as the target of the criminal Haejima. As days go by, not only Saki, but her friends, roommate and other acquaintances start to get involved in the crime scenes. Saki is now unaware of who is still her friend and her enemy. Would Saki ever be able to find out the truth behind the photos?

[Taken from the [url=http://www.productionig.com/contents/works_sp/29_/index.html]Production I.G official site[/url]]
translation:
本作是人气“YaruDora”系列的续作。主人公北泽沙纪是一名追逐独家新闻的摄影记者，目前以合约形式供职于一家小型制作公司。她的职业选择，深受曾是著名新闻记者、如今却已失踪的父亲影响。某天，她得到了一条关于知名摇滚乐手吉尔·索泽的丑闻线索，设法混入他的名流派对，拍下他与秘密女友的丑闻画面。然而，部分照片竟无意间记录了某桩犯罪的重要场面。自此，沙纪成了罪犯Haejima盯上的目标。随着日子过去，她的朋友、室友与其他熟人也相继卷入案件。如今，沙纪已分不清谁仍是朋友，谁又是敌人。她最终能揭开照片背后的真相吗？

[摘自[url=http://www.productionig.com/contents/works_sp/29_/index.html]Production I.G官方网站[/url]]
